says: The runner makes `admitted` with Schema `make` from a receipt whose `process` is the descriptor's id, decoded only as a string.
proof: In: next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/runtime.ts:162-168 decodes the stored descriptor as `SavedDescriptor`, whose `id`, `name`, `program` and `build` are only `Schema.String`, and the receipt's `process` is `process.id`. Make: next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Runner.ts:3133 `SupervisorMsg.cases.admitted.make({ seq, receipt })`, whose `receipt.process` is `ProcessId` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/internal/supervisor.ts:172).
cost: A value that fails the made schema, from a Project answer or the stored descriptor, now dies as a defect in the runner's generator. Before #1619 the plain literal went into `send` or `complete`, whose `Effect.try` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Runner.ts:771-774) turned the supervisor's own make into a typed `bad_row`. Every producer today is fabrika's own code, so it takes version skew between objects or a corrupt row.
